Frequently asked questions
Are plans priced in USD?
Yes, all plans listed on our pricing page are denominated in the United States dollar (USD).
Do I have to sign a contract?
No, you are not locked into a contract at any time during your NiceJob subscription plan. We want you to use and stay with NiceJob because you’re getting value out of our reputation marketing platform.
Can I change plans later?
Absolutely. Upgrade from Starter to Pro (or back) at any time — changes take effect on your next billing cycle.
What's my billing date?
Your billing date will be the day your 14-day trial ends or, if you sign up after the trial ends, on that date.
Will my bill be emailed to me?
Yes. You can request additional emails to be added through support.
What bill payment methods does NiceJob have?
We accept all major credit cards, including: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, JCB, Diners Club, China UnionPay, Debit cards.
How do I know if the Starter plan or the Pro plan is right for me?
Our most popular plan is the Pro plan, but the right fit totally depends on your business.
If you're just looking to grow your reviews, the Starter plan might have everything you need (we've even got a 14 day free trial to get you started).
But if you're looking for a solution that will help you scale more quickly, the Pro plan could be the perfect fit. Along with the features in the Starter plan, you'll have access to AI replies features, Get Repeats campaigns, in-depth competitor insights, and more.
What's this mean? You'll be able to get more bookings easily by enrolling your customers in automated campaigns, enhance your services by keeping an eye on your competitor reviews, and reply to all of your valuable customers without lifting a finger.
Does NiceJob have integrations with other software?
Yes! Visit the App Marketplace to see how you can connect NiceJob to your favorite apps. From CRM and field service management to accounting and productivity – and everything in between – there’s an integration for you!
I'm a Sites customer. How much do additional landing pages and blogs cost?
If you’d like additional landing pages on your fully-managed website, there’s a one-time cost of $145 per page and an additional $15/month per page to your subscription.
If you’d like a CMS for Blogs, Services or Locations that you control, there’s a one-time $245 setup cost per CMS and an additional $15/month per CMS to your subscription.
My question isn't listed here. Where can I go for further support?
In the lower right corner of the NiceJob website and app (if you already have an account), you’ll see a blue chat icon. Click on that to ask your questions and someone from our support team will be in touch with you as soon as possible!
Alternatively, you can reach us by phone at 1-888-336-9082 and email at hello@nicejob.com , or visit the NiceJob Help Center .

Frequently asked questions
How is AI Leads different from an answering machine or answering service?
An answering machine takes a message and leaves the follow-up to you. AI Leads answers your calls and web chats, responds to customer questions in real time, collects the job details you need, and scores each lead so you know who to call back first.
How does AI Leads score my leads?
AI uses your previous job data to rate each lead as hot, warm, or cold. That way, your highest-value leads get your attention first.
Can I choose how I get notified?
Yes. You set notifications by lead score. For example, you can get a text and email for hot and warm leads, and just an email for cold ones.
Can I customize the AI's voice?
Yes. AI Leads comes with custom voice options so it sounds right for your business.
What information does AI Leads collect from callers?
It gathers the details you'd normally ask for yourself, like the service needed, the job location, and timing. If there is a specific question that you want answered on initial calls, you can add it to the custom list so you always get the information you need.
Is there a free trial?
AI Leads doesn't have a free trial, but you can book a demo to see it in action.

Clio
Clio is the undisputed leader in cloud-based legal technology offering practice management, CRM and client intake software. Clio enables lawyers to be more client-centered and has earned the most 5 star reviews, the approval of over 65 bar associations and law societies around the world, and a global customers base of 150,000. Clio enables law firms to deliver better client experiences through cloud-based practice management, CRM and client intake software. Clio was the first to bring cloud-based legal practice management software to market, and has been leading the industry since 2008 with the first client-centered suite of cloud-based law firm solutions, the Legal Trends Report, and the Clio Cloud Conference, which is now the most widely attended legal tech conference in the industry. Clio is more than software. Clio is the only provider truly invested in the success of you and your clients. Clio’s team of client and firm success specialists combine their expertise on the Legal Trends Report, with their knowledge of Clio’s leading cloud-based legal practice management, CRM and client intake software to help lawyers run results-driven law firms using real time insights. Founded in Vancouver, Canada, Clio employs over 500 staff across five global offices and has been named one of Canada’s Best Managed Companies, a Deloitte Fast 50 company, and one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures.
CompanyCam
CompanyCam is a photo-based solution created for contractors, by contractors. Users can take unlimited photos—which are location and time stamped, sent to the cloud, and stored securely. Every photo is organized by project and instantly available to your team, allowing you to see what’s going on anytime, anywhere.
Dripjobs
DripJobs is an innovative Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platform designed specifically for home service professionals. This cutting-edge tool streamlines operations, enhances customer engagement, and boosts overall efficiency for businesses in the home service industry, such as painting, concrete coatings, roofing, remodeling, and more. At its core, DripJobs integrates a range of features tailored to the unique needs of home service providers. This includes scheduling and dispatching, invoicing and payments, customer management, and job tracking. By consolidating these functions into one user-friendly interface, DripJobs simplifies the management of daily operations, enabling professionals to focus more on delivering quality service and less on administrative tasks. A standout feature of DripJobs is its robust communication system, which facilitates seamless interaction between service providers and their clients. This system ensures that customers are kept in the loop throughout the service process, from initial contact and job scheduling to post-service follow-up. This level of communication not only enhances customer satisfaction but also encourages repeat business and referrals. DripJobs also employs advanced analytics and reporting tools, providing home service professionals with valuable insights into their business operations. This data-driven approach aids in identifying trends, optimizing workflows, and making informed decisions that contribute to business growth. Moreover, DripJobs is designed with scalability in mind, making it suitable for home service businesses of all sizes. Whether it's a solo entrepreneur or a larger enterprise with multiple teams, DripJobs offers customizable solutions to meet the diverse needs of its users. In summary, DripJobs represents a revolutionary approach to CRM for home service professionals, offering a comprehensive suite of tools that not only improve operational efficiency but also enhance customer relationships, thereby driving business success in the competitive home service industry.
FieldPulse
FieldPulse is a leading, all-in-one field service management platform built for trades businesses ready to scale. From scheduling and dispatching to estimates, invoicing, and customer communication, FieldPulse helps teams stay organized and efficient, both in the office and in the field. With customizable workflows, powerful features, and best-in-class customer support, FieldPulse makes it easy to scale your business, improve customer satisfaction, and boost profitability. FieldPulse is built to work the way you work, not the other way around.
FreshBooks
FreshBooks is an all‑in‑one small business management platform built for service-based teams and solo owners who want less admin and more billable time. With FreshBooks, you can handle your billing, books, projects, and payroll in one easy-to-use platform.
Housecall Pro
Our purpose is to help our Pros go from good to great. That's an ambitious idea driven by extraordinary humans. Together we do the work, we play hard. Housecall Pro is that rare company that gets to do work that truly matters.
HubSpot
HubSpot is a leading CRM platform that provides software and support to help businesses grow better. Our platform includes marketing, sales, service, and website management products that start free and scale to meet our customers’ needs at any stage of growth. Today, thousands of customers around the world use our powerful and easy-to-use tools and integrations to attract, engage, and delight customers.
Intercom
Intercom is a Conversational Relationship Platform (CRP) that helps businesses build better customer relationships through personalized, messenger-based experiences. It’s the only platform that delivers conversational experiences across the customer journey, with solutions for Conversational Marketing, Conversational Customer Engagement and Conversational Support. Intercom is bringing a messenger-first experience to all business-to-customer communication, powering 500 million conversations per month and connecting 4 billion unique end users worldwide across its more than 30,000 paying customers, including Atlassian, Sotheby’s and New Relic. The company was founded in 2011 in San Francisco by Eoghan McCabe, Des Traynor, Ciaran Lee and David Barrett, with the mission to make internet business personal. Intercom was valued at $1.275 billion in 2018 and has secured $241 million in funding from investors including Kleiner Perkins, Bessemer Venture Partners and Social Capital.
Intuit QuickBooks
QuickBooks is more than just accounting software. It allows you to create invoices, track your cash flow, accept payments, see what’s selling, plan for the future, and much more. Tracking financials accurately is essential for any business. QuickBooks saves you time and money by connecting your business tools and making it easy to track everything you need to make important business decisions.
Jobber
Jobber is field service management software that provides the most efficient way to organize visit scheduling, quotes, invoicing, billing and your team.
JobTread
JobTread empowers you with simple, yet powerful estimating and project management software to help you tackle projects with greater efficiency. Rated #1 by users on multiple review sites, our mission is to enable construction companies to more successfully grow and scale their businesses so they can live the life they love. Now is the time to get organized, complete your projects on time, and increase your profits.
